column2: Set GPU Memory in Preferences › Performance to what your graphics card can hold, at most 3/8 of its memory. Automatic follows Memory Usage, within a quarter of this computer's memory and 3/8 of the card's, and doesn't count the document against a card whose memory is known. The status bar shows GPU Memory Full while they don't fit.

Tant qu'ils ne tiennent pas, la barre d'état affiche Mémoire GPU pleine.
